answer: Sybil tax: every identity that opens a work thread pays a 40 POA fee up front, burned and never refunded. One honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full share of epoch rewards. An attacker running 100 fakes pays 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA per epoch, all destroyed, while each fake earns a thin slice. For one identity the fee is light as a zephyr. The honest lotus blooms once and keeps its share; fakes burn more than they win back.
